purpose: Fictional US Common Core study-design roles; no v2 simulations, participants or outcomes.
assignment_rules: All demographic, qualification, resource and workload details are fictional scenario assignments.
Skills, attitudes, languages and constraints are independently assigned; never derive them from identity.
Tool groups are deliberately uneven within the ten core roles and support no comparative inference.
Jev use means a hypothetical planning condition, never established adoption or access.
Do not apply v1 runs or timing to these revised profiles. Purchasing willingness remains unknown.
